newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan May trade surplus seen up 147 pct - Daiwa Bank.
newsitem.headline: Japan May trade surplus seen up 147 pct - Daiwa Bank.

text.p: Japan's customs-cleared trade surplus in May is expected to have risen by 147 percent from the year-ago period to 566 billion yen, Daiwa Bank Research Institute Inc said on Tuesday.
The May trade data are due on June 18.

Exports are forecast to have risen 25.2 percent in May to 4.265 trillion yen, as a weak yen helped boost the competitiveness of Japanese firms abroad, it said. Imports are seen having risen 16.5 percent to 3.699 trillion yen in May.

The Finance Ministry announced that Japan posted a customs-cleared trade surplus of 41.16 billion yen in the first 20 days of May, compared with a deficit of 180.94 billion yen in the same period a year earlier.
